sloka: मुद्गरैः आयसैः शूलैः प्रासैः खड्गैः परश्वधैः ।राक्षसाः समरे रामम् निजघ्नू रोष तत्पराः ॥३-२५-८॥
transliteration: mudgaraiḥ āyasaiḥ śūlaiḥ prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ ।rākṣasāḥ samare rāmam nijaghnū roṣa tatparāḥ ॥3-25-8॥

translations.english: Overtaken by anger, the demons continuously hurled at Rama hammers, spears, spikes, barbed missiles, swords and battleaxes.
